Paralegal (Corporate / Funds)

Aquis Search Limited

Our client, an international law firm, is looking for a Paralegal to join its Corporate and Funds practice in Hong Kong.

The role involves:

  • Drafting and reviewing transaction documents
  • Coordinating with offshore counsel on filings & registrations
  • Maintaining closing bibles and precedent banks

Candidates should have at least two years of paralegal experience in a law firm and be fluent in English and Chinese.
